purpose: Teach: 打倒/降伏/介在/適法/内在/剥奪/受刑/労働党

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染症打倒の取り組みを医療チームで継続しております
lines.en: Ren, we're continuing our efforts to combat infectious disease as a medical team.
lines.style: Even, composed delivery. Clinical precision without coldness. Brief pause after his name—professional but not distant. Steady eye contact level throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、降伏直後の戦災医療の歴史を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Yes, we refer to the history of post-war medical care right after the surrender in our team discussions.
lines.style: Patient, measured cadence. The weight of historical reference sits lightly in her voice. No rush to explain. Slight exhale at the comma—this is context, not justification.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 外部医師の介在事案を、貴院、ご経験されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has experienced cases where outside doctors have intervened, haven't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, not challenge. Soft opening. Respectful distance maintained—he's asking permission to understand, not pressing. Slight rise at the question mark, inviting her perspective.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、適法な治療手続きを医療チームで厳守します
lines.en: Yes, we maintain strict adherence to lawful treatment procedures as a team.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No defensiveness. The firmness is in the certainty, not the volume. Brief, clear—a statement of principle. Steady breathing throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんに内在する不安を、貴院、丁寧にケアされてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital takes such careful care of the anxiety that lives within patients, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine appreciation underneath the formal register. Not flattering—observing something true. Slight warmth on 'careful care'. The question trails gently, inviting her to acknowledge what she does.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医師資格剥奪事案を医療チームで分析します
lines.en: Yes, we analyze cases of medical license revocation as a team to learn from them.
lines.style: Clinical but not cold. The seriousness of the subject held steady in her voice. No emotion leak, but present—she feels the weight of what license loss means. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 受刑者の医療支援を、貴院、ご担当されてるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I hear your hospital handles medical support for incarcerated individuals. Is that right, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful curiosity, slight hesitation—aware this is weighty work. The question is genuine, not performative. Soft onset on 'I hear'. Pause before the tag question, giving her room to answer.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、労働党の医療公約を医療チームで分析します
lines.en: Yes, we analyze our team's medical policy commitments to ensure we're meeting them.
lines.style: Composed closer. Final statement carries quiet resolve. No rush. Slight exhale at the period—the conversation lands. Professional warmth—she's been present the whole time, and it shows at the end.
